title: AI Engineering Orchestra Agent Execution Authorization Evidence
description: Structural schema for one Agent Execution Authorization Evidence value defined by core/agent-execution-authorization-evidence-specification.md.

task_id.description: Exact Task identity from the bound Assignment.

workflow_id.description: Exact Workflow identity from the bound Assignment.

stage_id.description: Exact Workflow Stage identity from the bound Assignment.

role_id.description: Exact Role identity from the bound Assignment.

actor_id.description: Exact selected Actor identity from the bound Assignment.

runtime_option_id.description: Exact opaque reference to one caller-supplied Agent Runtime Option.

option_id.description: Exact opaque reference to one caller-supplied external Inference Option.

environment_id.description: Exact opaque caller-owned evaluation environment identity.

operation_id.description: Exact identifier of one Core-defined abstract operation.

authority_kind.description: Caller-attested kind of authority that made the decision elsewhere.

authority_id.description: Exact opaque caller-scoped authority identity; Core does not authenticate it.

provenance_reference.description: Exact opaque caller-supplied provenance reference; Core does not dereference or verify it.

state.description: Caller-attested authorization decision state for the exact action subject.
